probe_results.git_blobs_error: Resource not accessible by personal access token

evidence: TOKEN_EXPIRY=2027-05-11T19:00:00Z — same as previous sprint (token created 2026-05-11 with 1-year expiry). If a new token was regenerated today (2026-05-12), expiry would be 2027-05-12.

x-accepted-github-permissions=allows_permissionless_access=true — unchanged from previous sprint. This header confirms the fine-grained PAT still has no explicit resource scopes beyond public/permissionless access.
X-OAuth-Scopes is empty — consistent with fine-grained PAT that has no contents:write scope.
Git Data API /git/blobs returns HTTP 403 — identical to previous sprint failure.
diagnosis.conclusion: The GITHUB_PAT system environment variable most likely still contains the original token value from before the operator's permission changes. Fine-grained PATs on GitHub must be explicitly REGENERATED to get a new token string after permission edits — editing permissions on an existing token does not change the token value, the user must regenerate to get a new string. The old token string continues to have the old (no Contents:write) permissions even after the UI shows updated permissions.
diagnosis.secondary_possibility: Alternatively, a new token was created with the correct expiry date set manually to 2027-05-11 but still without Contents: Write scope.
